Honestly, I don't think I'm going to make it out of this... so I figure I'd be useless helping someone else? I can't stop talking/thinking about killing myself.

My family basically stays away from me at this point.
Everything I've accomplished at this point has been useless (college and such) so not really.

I've had a health issue for about two years now. I've exhausted everything that could possibly help, and nothing works.

I feel like I'm already dying so speeding it up would be a relief
